**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A square-ish white side plate, about 20 cm across. Area ≈ 314 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** Almonds only. No oil, dressing, or sauce is visible.

**STEP 4 - Area:** The almond pile covers roughly 30% of the plate, mostly as a single layer with some overlap. That is about 94 cm².

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Typical pile height is about 1.2 cm (almond thickness). 94 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 113 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Whole almonds pack loosely, with bulk density around 0.45–0.5 g/ml. 113 ml × 0.5 ≈ 56 g. Counting the visible nuts (about 40 at roughly 1.2 g each) gives about 48 g, so I'll take about 50 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Raw almonds are about 579 kcal/100 g. 50 g × 5.79 ≈ 290 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 40 almonds is a plausible small handful, and 50 g and about 290 kcal fit that. A full dinner plate would hold several hundred grams, which this is not.
